_readme: Young Men activity calendar, shown on orgs/young-men/. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/ym_activities.py --ics. To rebuild it from the leaders' sheet (tab YM Activities Calendar 2026), run: python3 tools/ym_activities.py path/to/sheet.txt. Do not add youth names, the Coordinators column, phone numbers, or home addresses. A home is stored as "Member Home (details from leaders)". quorums use deacons-quorum, teachers-quorum, priests-quorum. combined is ym, ymyw, stake, or empty. status is activity, tbd, none, or holiday. Mutual with no time is stored as 7:00 PM (Usual Mutual Time). Combined nights are one event, not one copy per quorum.
